title: Mounts registry
description: Other exobrain instances whose knowledge domains this one reads from a local checkout. Lives at the repo root. Each machine enables a mount, and may point it at an existing checkout, in its gitignored .exobrain.json under mounts.<name> ({enabled, path}); by default the checkout is src/<name>/ in the main checkout. Only knowledge domains are indexed — never the mount's specs, hooks, skills, tools, scopes, or its own mounts. See knowledge/exobrain/mounts.md.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema, for editor autocomplete and validation.

name.description: Unique kebab-case id. Names the default checkout (src/<name>/) and prefixes each mounted domain in the knowledge index (<name>/<domain>); must not equal a local domain's directory name.

repo.description: Clone URL of the mounted instance. An existing checkout is accepted when its origin is the same repository in any URL spelling.

audience.description: Who can read that repository, shown beside its domains in the knowledge index — a fact is recorded there only when everyone named here may read it.

skip_domains.description: Domain directory names of the mount left out of the index — typically its own framework meta-domain, which duplicates this instance's.
